sections.title: Indianapolis Industry Specializations
sections.description: ClickMasters builds AI specifically for Indianapolis's dominant and distinctive industry sectors.

items.title: Pharmaceutical and Life Sciences (Eli Lilly's Home)
items.description: Eli Lilly and Company (Indianapolis HQ, one of the world's largest pharmaceutical companies) is the single most significant driver of Indianapolis's pharmaceutical AI market. Drug discovery AI: molecular property prediction, target identification, hit-to-lead optimization, and ADMET modeling. Manufacturing process AI: pharmaceutical manufacturing PAT (process analytical technology) AI — predicting product quality from process parameters during drug manufacture. Clinical trial optimization: patient recruitment ML, protocol optimization, and site performance prediction. Pharmacovigilance: adverse event signal detection from post-market surveillance data.
items.label: Pharmaceutical

items.title: Healthcare (IU Health and the Indianapolis Hospital Market)
items.description: Indiana University Health (Indianapolis HQ, Indiana's largest health system with 16+ hospitals), Ascension St. Vincent, Community Health Network, and Franciscan Health. HIPAA-compliant clinical AI with Epic EHR integration for Indianapolis's major health systems.
items.label: Healthcare

items.title: Logistics and Distribution
items.description: Indianapolis's extraordinary highway intersection (the 'Crossroads of America') and FedEx's Indianapolis hub make it one of the Midwest's most important logistics markets. Supply chain AI, demand forecasting for Indianapolis-centered distribution operations, and freight analytics for Indiana's logistics community.

items.title: Manufacturing
